status_note: Config-driven model registry, grouped evaluator, and record aggregation are implemented and tested. The full repeated subject-grouped cross-validation comparison on the P4a feature table has NOT been run; no candidate is frozen and no UNKNOWN/REJECT threshold is set.
task: fixed-posture 5-class subject-isolated candidate comparison via repeated subject-grouped cross-validation

preprocessing.principle: imputer/scaler are always inside each candidate Pipeline and are fitted per fold on that fold's training subjects only, never on the full table
preprocessing.imputation: SimpleImputer(strategy=median) for the 22 NaN empty/WARN rows (principal_axis/anisotropy)
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler for distance and gradient-based estimators

evaluation_protocol.all_candidates_share_folds: every candidate is evaluated on the exact same subject folds (same seeds/config) so rankings are comparable
evaluation_protocol.preprocessing_per_fold: only fitted on training subjects of each fold
evaluation_protocol.no_unseen_popu_test_claim: all 60 PoPu subjects were already used as dev OOF or held-out in P5 v0.1, so there is no re-nameable 'never-seen' PoPu test. P5.1 ranks candidates with repeated grouped CV; P5 v0.1 held-out results stay as historical first-round exploration evidence.

model_selection.scope: grouped-CV out-of-fold predictions only; never reads any historical held-out test

evaluation_levels.record: mean-probability aggregation over the 10 snapshots of each PoPu record (record_id = source_relative_path); label/group conflicts are rejected
evaluation_levels.subject: per-group/per-subject accuracy and macro-F1 reported alongside snapshot metrics; worst subject is flagged

external_validation.limitation: P5.1 cannot restore an unseen PoPu test. Real external confirmation is deferred to SLP/PressurePose/PMD tasks where applicable and to future self-developed synchronized data; those datasets must be evaluated separately and never row-joined with PoPu.
